messages:
Priya: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem recap. I'm listing concrete remediation tasks and owners so we can track in one thread. Keep replies short.

Priya: REMEDIATION SUMMARY:
- Token validation hardening: add signature+expiry double-check + tamper fuzz tests. owner: Omar. ETA: 2026-04-04. ticket: SEC-5781.
- Permission drift detector: daily job that snapshots effective permissions and alerts on spikes. owner: Jin. ETA: 2026-04-08. ticket: SEC-5790.
- Audit log completeness: ensure all auth decisions emit request_id, user_id, policy_version. owner: Claire. ETA: 2026-03-31. ticket: SEC-5778.
- Secrets rotation validation: automated rotation in staging with post-rotation smoke tests + rollback doc. owner: Infra. ETA: 2026-04-12. ticket: OPS-2402.
- Recurrence analysis: run a 30d pattern check to detect repeated permission flaps. owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-04-06.

Omar: taking token validation. Plan: add `authn/expiry_guard` middleware, integrate sig-check into token parsing, and add CI fuzz tests that flip bits and test TTL edge cases. Will open PR `github.com/redwood/authn/pull/402`. Canary rollout: 2% traffic + circuit-breaker.

Jin: permission drift detector plan: use policy-snapshot exporter to S3, then a small lambda to diff and send alerts to #sec-alerts. Will prototype job schedule and alert thresholds. Need list of high-risk services to ignore noise.

Claire: Audit log work: will update the logging library to add structured fields: `request_id`, `user_id`, `policy_version`, `outcome`. Will add an alert rule when `policy_version` is missing. Pushing schema to internal docs.

Infra: will run a canary rotation in staging tomorrow 03:00 UTC and publish the runbook steps. We'll include a smoke test that hits the API for token mint/validate cycles and integration with HSM.

Priya: Notes: For token tests, please include clock-skew scenarios and replayed tokens. For drift detector, start with 7-day and 30-day windows. For audit logs, keep JSON schema compact to avoid ingestion costs.

Omar: ack. I'll include a small eval script `tools/token-fuzz` that generates tampered tokens and asserts failure.

Jin: adding ticket SEC-5790 and will gather list of services to suppress false positives. ETA stays 2026-04-08.

Claire: posted schema: `{"event":"auth_decision","request_id":"...","user_id":"...","policy_version":"v1.2.3","outcome":"allow|deny"}` link: https://redwood.internal/docs/audit-schema

sec-bot: Created incident follow-up: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/1845003210>. Reminder set: /remind #incidents in 4 days to update progress.

Priya: Let's add measurable success criteria to each item:
- Token validation: 0 token-accepts with expired signature across 7-day synthetic runs.
- Drift detector: alerts <= 3 false positives per week after tuning.
- Audit logs: 100% of auth decisions have required fields in staging and prod within 72h of deploy.
- Rotation: successful automated rotation in staging + documented rollback tested end-to-end.

Omar: added measurable checks to SEC-5781.

Jin: will add a baseline run and post results here.

Infra: scheduled rotation run and will attach logs to OPS-2402.

Priya: If anyone hits blockers, mark ticket with `blocked` and ping me. We'll do a short demo next Tuesday showing tests + rotation runbook. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
